draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and pragmatic, assessing value while browsing a store
notes: Pronounced piányi (with a neutral tone on 宜), even though 便 is most often read biàn (as in 方便 fāngbiàn 'convenient').
Its opposite is 贵 (guì, 'expensive'). It simply means low-priced and does not imply poor quality.
